rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=1, pretrain_steps=20, n_iter=30, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=3, img_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_kernel=7, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, batch_size=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, outer_wall_s=1050, per_scene_s=None, seed=42, rationale=iter-19 EMPTY-PATCH EXHAUSTION CONFIRM (PER-IMAGE preserved: warm-start pre-pass + per-scan 6-param bilateral fit, never amortized). All 18 prior iters hr0 at SSIM~0.9253 plateau (max iter-14 0.925481; iters 10/12/14 tied within 2e-4 noise). Six-box: failure mode = per-image bilateral N2I odd/even half-view split is PSNR/RMSE-gated below the LD-FBP headroom floor (PSNR 34.03 dB, RMSE 9.9e-4) — structural regime bound, NOT tuning. Every per-image in-budget lever mapped: proj_n_bf 1/2/3 saturates@3, img_n_bf 2 HURTS (0.897), proj_kernel 5/7 flat, proj_sy 2.0/0.5 flat, proj_sr 0.02/5e-4 worse, lr 5e-3 beats 3e-4, seed 42/123 flat. Fixed knobs (n_iter/pretrain_epochs/pretrain_steps/grad_clip/img sigmas) are either already-exhausted on sibling per-image dual_domain_n2i or capacity-adds that img_n_bf=2 proves counterproductive in this gated regime — no credible in-budget path off hr0. DECISION: confirmed exhausted. Empty-patch from BASE_ITER=14 (max-SSIM) re-documents the half-view ceiling. No anomaly.
